boundary: Original box clipping at intermediate RK4 stages and completed updates
integrator: Original RK4 numerical operations; fixed coefficients calculated once from the prescribed S or I cloud
horizon: Existing FD-201 8/lambda1 rounded to the 0.05 step grid and shared by every matched method, rank, budget and coefficient regime
cache_policy: Existing training trajectories, targets and FD spectra are read-only and mandatory. Existing learned spectra are reused; a missing learned spectrum alone may be fitted with the original initializer and stored in this supplement.
selection_policy: All prescribed seeds, budgets and ranks are retained. No best-budget selection or replacement of failed runs.
domain_expansion: Deferred because changing pot.box also changes the projected process, dictionaries and FD spacing
